result.explanation: Use the direct capacity rule: accept a reservation only when its identifier is unused, its interval and units are valid, and every instant's total active units stays within capacity. Cancellation removes an existing reservation.
result.mapping: Reservations map to active interval records; capacity maps to the maximum pointwise overlap; output units maps to the sum of active reservation units.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated identifier, numeric, event-count, and endpoint bounds. State is only the JSON state returned by this program.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){var c=input.config.capacity,m={},o=[];function eq(a,b){return JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b)}function snap(status){var k=Object.keys(m).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<k.length;i++)u+=m[k[i]][2];return {status:status,active:k,units:u}}function ok(x){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,x.id)||!Number.isInteger(x.start)||!Number.isInteger(x.end)||x.start>=x.end||!Number.isInteger(x.units)||x.units<1||x.units>c)return false;var q=Object.keys(m).map(function(k){return m[k]}).concat([[x.start,x.end,x.units]]);for(var t=0;t<=100;t++){var z=0;for(var i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i][0]<=t&&t<q[i][1])z+=q[i][2];if(z>c)return false}return true}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],s;if(e.type==='reserve'){if(ok(e)){m[e.id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];s=snap('reserved')}else s=snap('rejected')}else{if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,e.id)){delete m[e.id];s=snap('cancelled')}else s=snap('missing')}o.push(s)}return eq(o,output)}
result.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config.capacity,s=x.state||{r:{}},r=s.r,e=x.event,id=e.id;function snap(st){var a=Object.keys(r).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)u+=r[a[i]][2];return {state:{r:r},output:{status:st,active:a,units:u}}}if(e.type==='cancel'){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)){delete r[id];return snap('cancelled')}return snap('missing')}var good=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=c;if(good){var q=Object.keys(r).map(function(k){return r[k]}),z; q.push([e.start,e.end,e.units]);for(var t=0;t<=100;t++){z=0;for(var i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i][0]<=t&&t<q[i][1])z+=q[i][2];if(z>c){good=false;break}}}if(good)r[id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];return snap(good?'reserved':'rejected')}
